reported.title: Heartbeat blocked during siren burst
reported.description: runSirenBurst() calls delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38, which blocks the loop for the full 2000 ms so the heartbeat check at lines 60-65 cannot run. Measured gaps of 2000-2249 ms between 'hb' lines confirm the heartbeat is starved while the siren is active. Expected /^hb$/ every 250 ± 100 ms; 5 of 5 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2249 ms.

reported.title: Firmware silent for 2000 ms during siren
reported.description: The blocking delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38 produces no serial output and no pin change for the entire 2000 ms pulse, far exceeding the 700 ms limit. Measured silence of 2000 ms (e.g. 500.008 to 2500.017 ms) confirms the firmware goes unresponsive during each burst. Firmware went silent for 2000 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 5 such gap(s).

judge_input.spec:
- Kiln door switch on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); siren driver on D8.
- A settled door-open press as short as 40 ms starts a 2000 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 150 ms.
- While a siren pulse is already running, additional presses are ignored (do not restart the pulse).
- Print the exact line `hb` every 250 ms at all times, including during the siren pulse.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no pin change) for more than 700 ms.
- Idle door contact reads HIGH.
